ipClearance: Original implementation and visuals. Placing polyominoes on a grid and clearing full rows and columns is a genre-standard puzzle mechanic and not protectable; no names, art or layouts are taken from existing titles.
notes: Drag control, flat difficulty. Exercises: rotate and place {col,row} events, invalid placements ignored, one placement per tick, cyclic 240-piece queue, auto-discard of unplaceable pieces. The concept ran 90 s; this ships at 60 s to fit F1's 25–60 s range.
